title: Why they call it that
html_source:
The word arsenic … was adopted into Greek as arsenikon (ἀρσενικόν), a form that is folk etymology, being the neuter form of the Greek word arsenikos (ἀρσενικός), meaning “male”, “virile”. The Greek word was adopted in Latin as arsenicum, which in French became arsenic, from which the English word arsenic is taken.
